logo-red.purpose: Whole fields and action, at full strength only. Ramp shown for reference; the system never uses tints.

paper.purpose: Page stock; type on red and ink.

stone.purpose: Default border, soft rules, segment hover.

display.purpose: Hero statement and page titles only; wdth 125, up to 7rem on page titles.

title.purpose: Operation titles, machine names, people, certificate standards; wdth 112.

label.purpose: Uppercase register keys, intake captions, folios, sub-list headings.

rules.name: sheet-rule
rules.purpose: Opens every sheet, register, index and the header bottom.

rules.name: soft-rule
rules.purpose: Default border; quiet dividers in the mobile menu.

rules.name: column-tick
rules.value: 1px x 10px, 12 per sheet (7 on the hero field)

motion.name: tick-wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0); 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 120ms delay, once
motion.purpose: The single load motion: the hero tick line draws across the red field.

motion.name: procession-track
motion.value: transform scaleX(0) to scaleX(1); 1600ms steps(4, jump-start), once on 50% intersection
motion.purpose: Red track runs across the four operations.

motion.name: spec-deploy
motion.purpose: Spec sheet opening in place from a machine index row.

motion.name: underline-bar
motion.purpose: Desktop nav hover/current red bar; index arrow nudge 4px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations 0.01ms; tick wipe off; procession never armed (track shows complete); hero video paused on poster

focus.value: outline 3px solid #e30016, offset 2px; white outline inside red fields

photography.caption: FOTO NN / PHOTO NN in tabular figures, then a dot and the caption
photography.cutouts: machine cutouts multiplied onto paper (mix-blend-mode multiply)

openItems: Certificate numbers, issuers and validity dates pending.
Real shop photography pending from the client; current photos are placeholders.

components.css: :host{--color-red:#e30016;--color-ink:#1b1918;--color-paper:#fff;--color-stone:#d9d6d0;--color-mid:#5f5a55;--gutter:clamp(16px,2.2vw,32px);--font:'Archivo Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-ops{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:2px solid #1b1918;font-family:'Archivo Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-ops::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:-2px;height:6px;width:100%;background:#e30016;transform-origin:left;animation:ds-run 1600ms steps(4,jump-start) both}.ds-ops li{padding:22px 16px 26px}.ds-ops li+li{border-left:1px solid #1b1918}.ds-ops b{display:block;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:700;color:#e30016;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-ops h4{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:1.375rem;font-weight:750;font-stretch:112%;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.1;color:#1b1918}@keyframes ds-run{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ops::before{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Identity Manual"**

The site is the firm's own 1970s-style corporate identity manual: every section is a numbered sheet that opens on a heavy ink rule, with the twelve columns of the page grid drawn as ticks hanging from that rule. White stock, ink type, and the logo red at full strength owning whole fields. Order is the message: an orderly page reads as an orderly shop.

Density is that of a reference document, not a brochure. Facts are set in registers (label left, value right, hairline under each row), machines are an index of numbered rows, the process is a sequence of numbered operations. Photography is shown in natural colour and numbered like manual plates. There are no cards, no shadows, no blur, no rounded corners; structure comes only from grid modules and rules. The previous cream, glow-and-frosted-glass system was discarded entirely and nothing from it carries over.
keyCharacteristics: One logo red at full strength, owning whole fields (hero, people band, request band) and marking action; never tinted, never a gradient.
Sheets open on a 2px ink rule with the visible 12-column tick line and a folio ("List 02" / "Sheet 02") on the rule at the right.
One family, Archivo Variable, with the wide cut for display and tabular figures for every number.
Registers, indexes and numbered operations instead of cards.
One load motion (the tick-line wipe across the red field) and one scroll procession (the stepped red track over the operations).

rules.name: The Full-Strength Rule
rules.body: Red appears at 100% or not at all. No tints, no opacity, no gradients, no red-on-red tones. A red area is a whole field or a whole action, never a wash.

rules.name: The Red Means Owned-Or-Action Rule
rules.body: Red either owns an entire region of the grid or marks something the buyer can act on, plus the numbering that orders the manual. It is never decoration on an otherwise neutral block.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only. Hierarchy is made with width and weight, never with a second face.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular figures so registers, indexes and phone numbers align like a printed table.

rules.name: The Visible Grid Rule
rules.body: The twelve columns are drawn, not implied. New sheets open with the tick-line rule, and content snaps to the columns those ticks mark.

rules.name: The Folio-On-The-Rule Rule
rules.body: Sheet numbers sit on the rule at the right edge, small and tabular. Nothing small and uppercase is stacked above a heading.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or a field, never with a shadow, a card or a floating panel.

dos: **Do** let logo red own an entire grid region or mark an action, at full strength only.
**Do** open every sheet with the 2px ink rule, the twelve-tick line and a folio on the rule at the right.
**Do** build content as registers, indexes and numbered sequences separated by 2px rules and 1px hairlines.
**Do** set every number in tabular figures and number things the way a manual does (01, 010, FOTO 01).
**Do** show photography in natural colour and caption it with its plate number.

**Do** keep motion to the tick-line wipe on load, the stepped procession track, the spec-sheet deploy and short linear state changes; under reduced motion all of it stops (the hero video stays on its poster frame and the track shows complete).
donts: **Don't** tint, fade or gradient the red, or use a second accent color.
**Don't** use shadows, blur, glass, rounded corners or cards.
**Don't** set a small uppercase label above a heading; folios belong on the rule, and labels key registers or name sub-lists.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or a system display face; width and weight of Archivo carry the hierarchy.
**Don't** use unnumbered images, or filter, tint or duotone photographs.
**Don't** add icon glyphs beyond the drawn 2px arrow and phone stroke.
